subject.title: RFC: add local adaptive-refresh replay tooling

question: Should CodexBar upstream own and maintain AdaptiveReplayCLI and its package-internal replay framework?
rationale: VISION.md explicitly reserves new features, package changes, broad architecture, and meaningful maintenance complexity for owner sign-off; code correctness cannot decide that repository boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the offline CLI
options.body: Accept the executable and internal replay modules upstream while preserving the current no-recorder, no-network, and no-default-change boundary.

options.title: Keep replay tooling external
options.body: Decline the permanent package product and leave comparative analysis in contributor-maintained external tooling.

options.title: Request a smaller experiment
options.body: Ask for a substantially narrower script or temporary artifact before adopting a maintained Swift executable and framework.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the offline CLI
recommendation.body: Accept the executable and internal replay modules upstream while preserving the current no-recorder, no-network, and no-default-change boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and package-surface decision owner, steipete is the best available authority for accepting the new product and maintenance boundary.
